Definition: {to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)}
BiblicalUsage: 1) to set, make, appoint; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to make, make decree, setout (decree); 1a2) to make, appoint; 1a3) to set, fix; 1b) (Ithp'al) to be made, be set, be laid
